scope: Synthetic JPEG profile and one paired fixture diagnostic; no native UI acceptance or general performance claim.

profile.optimization_evidence: Successful native build receipt; the sample header itself does not encode compiler flags.
profile.conversion: Printed weighted call tree; self weight equals parent inclusive weight minus direct children. All thread totals and 52 reported top-of-stack rows reconcile. Graph groups generated continuations/islands, preserving weights.
limitations: One sampled window, not a complete decode or a timeline.
Weights are stack observations, not function calls or exact CPU milliseconds.
Generated work-loop dispatch does not preserve the full logical Bend call chain. Generic runtime samples cannot all be attributed to IDCT.
No optimized latency, Swift comparison, or cross-host timing comparison.

paired_fixture.environment: Same Linux x86_64 host for both variants
paired_fixture.fixture: 1024 x 640 baseline JPEG, 4:4:4, only end-of-block symbols in its selected AC Huffman tables; DC-only admitted blocks.
paired_fixture.measurement: First-invocation monitored process wall time, including fixture assertions; baseline then candidate.
paired_fixture.oracle: Independent input SHA, geometry, 24 exact selected pixels and explicit progressive refusal; not full raster equality.
paired_fixture.tool_evidence: Clang and mise binary hashes match before/after. Bun version checked before builds; one isolated installation; Bun binary hash recorded only at postflight.
limitations: One run per variant; no warmup, cache reset, repetition, variance estimate or statistical claim.
The fixture is DC-only; this does not measure arbitrary JPEG inputs.
The timed process also checks decoding inputs, selected pixels and unsupported progressive input.
This is not a macOS, Swift, UI, optimized-build, or end-to-end import timing.

publication_sanitization: Derived counts and hashes only; raw traces, machine names, absolute paths, process identifiers and reference source are omitted.
